I just want to point out that most projects similar to tiny11 strongly recommend having a full windows install available such that any issue can be narrowed down properly if it's due to tiny11 or not.

VRChats implementation of avpro uses media foundation. I haven't been able to find a non VR program that works the same, apparently deovr can be told to use directshow or not, the latter being Media foundation.

I did find an example project, but haven't tried it yet. https://github.com/microsoft/media-foundation/tree/master/samples/MediaEngineUWPSample
I reckon this should be labelled as closed and it should be noted that you should check your bases and prepare for potential random incompatibilities that occur with custom / moddel OS's.
Because the issue resolved itself (after installing WMP), but I imagine missing / reduced packages on modded OS's such as Tiny10 or Tiny11 isn't all too common.

details:
During my time on VRChat [Past month], ALL Video players using yt-dlp, AVPro, or the Unity video player, have failed to load videos throwing the same [or similar] error in the output log. No modifications to the VRChat client, config, launch options, Windows 11 OS, nor firewall have been made during this period [before and after the issue arose.] I [Yesterday] had a fellow user report having the same issue, however the circumstance was different, being it would take 10 minutes for a video to load after throwing an error, and uniquely enough stated his issue randomly [???] resolved itself from which at one point ALL video players started working for him again. Due to the nature of this issue, I do doubt it will be consistent across all systems, and its very unclear if it is an issue with the VRChat client, or the yt-dlp or AVPro modules.

The following are to be given:

• The system firewall and hosts file are empty, and VRChat is on the Windows Defender whitelist [performance headroom]

• The operating system is Windows 11, or more specifically tiny11 [windows 11 gets more bloated with each update]

• The launch options for VRChat on steam are empty and remain [afaik] unmodified.

• The VRChat client itself is EAC compliant and is unmodified.

• The VRCCache is 512 GB big [as seen in the output log.]

• The system running VRChat is optimized for VRChat itself, and idles at 1-2%.

• Untrusted URL's are [and always have been] ON!

• I have attempted to run VRChat with VSync both OFF and ON for the prior launches to the video, [after consulting to the help page.] it [in this instance] is OFF. (same error was thrown each time)

• System specs, [asides from GPU, which is RTX 3070, are attached]

• For demonstration purposes I used an empty gameobject for an avatar to demonstrate a stutter that occurs after entering the URL that happens just before the Error message displays.

• I have completely cleared all of my caches in the Debug tab and it did not solve the error.

• NOTE: Clearing local profile data, relogging, then pasting the URL into the video player crashed the VRChat client, additionally. Its crash log will be supplied in the secondary debug log.

YT video demonstrating the bug in action [resultingly steps to recreate are not included as the video shows such]:

https://youtu.be/3RUtiIFUblc
